name: Prijsvrij Vakanties
verdict: Prijsvrij Vakanties is a private Dutch travel operator under Prijsvrij Travel Holding; DER Touristik (REWE Group) holds a 50 percent stake. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Privately held travel group (founder Marc van Deursen); 50% held by DER Touristik, part of family-owned REWE Group. No state or fund ownership. Feyenoord's back-of-shirt partner through season 2026-27.
